notes:
Summary: Canadian-headquartered fintech (Toronto) exploring Redwood Private (VPC) for customer-facing chat + doc search across regulated lines. Primary requirement is Canada-only data residency with optional UK/EU separation for certain subsidiaries.

Key asks / constraints: 
- Full KMS integration (customer-managed keys) for secrets and model artifacts.
- Audit logging to be shipped to customer SIEM (Splunk) with 1-year retention and exportable immutable logs.
- Data residency zoning: primary tenant in Canada region; EU-only dataset for EU legal entities and UK separation for PII.
- Network: must support strict CIDR whitelisting, egress controls, and private endpoints to on-prem data stores.
- Compliance: SOC2 + ISO27001 required; legal needs contract language on data processing and sub-processors.

Quotes / call snippets: 
- "We cannot have customer PII leave Canada — that's non-negotiable for this product line." — Head of Data Governance
- "If we can get KMS BYOK + audit exports we can pilot next quarter." — CTO

Model / performance notes: 
- Preferred models: open LLM family (quantized 34B / 70B) validated for production; fallback to smaller quantized variants for cost-sensitive flows.
- Latency targets: 95th percentile < 350ms for chat, concurrent throughput target ~500 qps for embeddings backfills (batching acceptable).
- Cost sensitivity: high for embeddings/backfill; will leverage Redwood Optimize recommendations.

Current status: security review initiated (SAQ sent), netsec preparing firewall requirements, infra team scoping private VPC deployment topology. POC requested: KMS rotation + audit log webhook to Splunk + small chat traffic in Canada region.

- 2026-02-22 pricing review with procurement — asked for reserved capacity options and data residency surcharge.

Risk flags: legal wants proof of no third-party processing outside Canada; product team needs to validate fallback behavior for model upgrades without cross-region replication.

- Share sample audit log exports and Splunk ingestion instructions.
- Prepare architecture diagram for Canada-only tenant with EU/UK carve-outs.
